mapper.select: SELECT ChnlCode, EventCode, EventName, EventDesc, EventStartDate, EventEndDate, ImgName, ImgLink, ImgWidth, ImgHeight, EventHtml, StoreCode, ParentEventCode, EventLevel, EventSeq, AdultYn, ColCnt, ReviewYn, TmplCode, BoardYn, State, Remark, RegistDate, RegistId, RegistName, ChangeDate, ChangeId, ChangeName FROM shopion.tStrEvent WHERE ChnlCode = #{pChnlCode} AND EventCode = #{pEventCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tStrEvent ( ChnlCode, EventCode, EventName, EventDesc, EventStartDate, EventEndDate, ImgName, ImgLink, ImgWidth, ImgHeight, EventHtml, StoreCode, ParentEventCode, EventLevel, EventSeq, AdultYn, ColCnt, ReviewYn, TmplCode, BoardYn, State, Remark, RegistDate, RegistId, RegistName, ChangeDate, ChangeId, ChangeName ) VALUES ( #{chnlCode}, #{eventCode}, #{eventName}, #{eventDesc}, #{eventStartDate}, #{eventEndDate}, #{imgName}, #{imgLink}, #{imgWidth}, #{imgHeight}, #{eventHtml}, #{storeCode}, #{parentEventCode}, #{eventLevel}, #{eventSeq}, #{adultYn}, #{colCnt}, #{reviewYn}, #{tmplCode}, #{boardYn}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registDate}, #{registId}, #{registName}, #{changeDate}, #{changeId}, #{changeName} )
